## 12. Checkpoints

**Files:** `src/checkpoints.ts`, `src/slots/Checkpoints.tsx`, `Checkpoints.module.css`. Behavior: PRD §4. Look: DESIGN.md Checkpoints, Menus.

- Names: `checkpointTitle(p, n)` → `Checkpoint N · <name>` when `p.checkpointNames[n]` is set, else `Checkpoint N`; every place that names a Checkpoint uses it, so a name never goes missing anywhere. `withNames(p, text)` puts `checkpointTitle` in place of every `Checkpoint <digits>` in a saved text (a chat `line`, a code-only `label`), so those follow renames too. `renameCheckpoint(p, n, name)` (recipe, an Undo step): trim, cut to 40 characters, blank deletes the name.
- In `model/project.ts` (pure): `canvasOf(p)` = a clone of `{ blocks, traits, defs, assets }`; the name, chat and id counters are not in a Checkpoint. `holding(p, cps)`: the Checkpoint whose `files` and `canvas` equal the Project's (a JSON compare, so positions count). `makeCheckpoint(p, number, saved?)` = `{ projectId, number, saved, from: p.checkpoint, files: clone, canvas: canvasOf(p), time }`.
- `saveCheckpoint(saved = 'Saved by you')`: add `makeCheckpoint(p, cps.length + 1, saved)`, then `p.checkpoint` = its number (no Undo step). Returns the number.
- `applyRestore(p, c)` (recipe): `files` and the four canvas fields become clones of the Checkpoint's; `p.checkpoint = c.number`.
- `restoreCheckpoint(number, save)`: find it; when `save` and no `holding`, `saveCheckpoint('Saved before restoring Checkpoint ' + number)`. `updateProject(d => applyRestore(d, c), null)`. If `hasPending` → `dropPending('Code went back to Checkpoint ' + number)`. `flashBlocks([])`.
- `warning(p, cps, c)` → `{ title, lines, unsaved }` (`Checkpoint N` is `checkpointTitle(p, N)`): title `Restore Checkpoint N?`; `Your Blocks and code go back to how they were at Checkpoint N.`; `unsaved` = no `holding` → `You have changes that are not in a Checkpoint.`; `hasPending` → `The Assistant's unaccepted changes will be dropped.`
- `gist(c, p)`: `saved` → `withNames(p, saved) + '.'`; a Site top (or none) → `Before Build: the whole site.`; else `Before Build: adds <names>.` where names = walking from its canvas top: an unlocked Block adds its name (not deeper); a locked one adds its name only if it has Traits or a Note, then walks its children; empty → `changes`.
- `fromTag(c, p)`: `from` set and not `number - 1` → `from <checkpointTitle(p, from)>`; else none.
- `buildOf(id, p, cps)`: `made(c)` = `requestBlocks(c.canvas, top of c.canvas)` includes id. Walk from `p.checkpoint` back through `from`; the first `made` wins; else the newest `made` in the list.

**Checkpoints.tsx:** loads `listCheckpoints` on Project id, `p.checkpoint` and a reload counter. Header like the Library's (§16; its classes are composed): h2 `Checkpoints`, hint `Saved versions of your Blocks and code. Every Build saves one first.`, and **Save Checkpoint** (the Upload button's look), disabled with title `Nothing new to save.` while `holding` is set, and disabled while a Build starts or runs. Save → `saveCheckpoint()`, reload, then the new entry's name field opens (as Rename). Empty list → a centered `div` (class `empty`): `<img src="/bob-head.svg" alt="">` (48px) above `No Checkpoints yet. Save one, or Build, and it shows up here.` Entries newest first:
- Title row: `checkpointTitle(p, N)` (h3), right after it a rename button (the 14px fill `PencilSimple` icon, title `Rename`, aria-label `Rename Checkpoint N`), the time (`toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })`), the from tag, and on the current one (`p.checkpoint === number`, entry class `here`) `you are here` + (` + changes` when it is not the `holding` one).
- Rename: the h3 becomes `Checkpoint N` followed by an input (autofocus, `maxLength` 40, aria-label `Name for Checkpoint N`, starting with the current name; the rename button hides meanwhile). Enter → `updateProject(d => renameCheckpoint(d, N, draft))` when the trimmed draft differs from the name; Escape or blur cancels. After Enter or Escape the focus goes back to the rename button.
- Gist. Buttons: **Restore** (disabled while a Build starts or runs) and **Show its Blocks** / **Hide its Blocks** (a link-style toggle, `aria-expanded`) when its canvas has a top.
- Open: a read-only tree `ul` of its Blocks from its canvas top: each row icon (lock for locked, puzzle for Instances, else the type's) + name + file; class `cat-<cat>` (none → `built` for locked or site); click picks it. A picked row with code in the current files (`findBlockCode`) shows `</> See its code` (→ `seeItsCode(id)`, stops propagation).
- From a Block chip: when `useCheckpointFocus()` is set and the list is loaded: open `buildOf(focus)`, pick that Block with `flash` (it scrolls to the center and flashes twice), clear the focus.
- Restore opens `Warning` with `warning(...)`. `unsaved`: confirm `Save and restore` (→ `restoreCheckpoint(N, true)`) and `other` `Restore without saving` (→ `restoreCheckpoint(N, false)`); else confirm `Restore`. Then close and reload; an error logs `Restoring the Checkpoint failed`.
- `Warning({ title, lines, confirm, danger?, other?, onCancel, onConfirm })` (exported): a native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`; `onClose` cancels (Escape); `h2` title; a `p` per line; **Cancel** (text), then `other` when given (ghost), then the confirm (Primary, autofocus).
